description: This file defines the interface IEventHandler for handling OCI container events within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares pure virtual methods for different container events such as start, stop, failure, and state change.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface class that declares callback methods for OCI container lifecycle events.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStartedEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when an OCI container starts, providing the container name and event data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStoppedEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when an OCI container stops, providing the container name and event data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerFailureEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when an OCI container encounters a failure, providing the container name and event data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when an OCI container changes state, providing the container name and event data.
